text: 62-year-old male. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor

The absence of systemic symptoms helps narrow down the differential, but the chronic, non-healing nature of these painless lesions in a smoker with African heritage remains highly suspicious for malignancy, particularly squamous cell carcinoma or extragenital condyloma that has undergone malignant transformation. I need to visualize the morphology of these lesions to distinguish between premalignant changes like erythroplasia of Queyrat and frank carcinoma, so I will request a close-up view.
